subject: Drop the price ticker from the hero, add the hero video prompt
body:
The scrolling quote strip showed invented prices under an "illustrative"
label on a broker's front page. Removing it loses nothing real and takes a
distraction off the first screen.

Hero video support was already there; docs/hero-video-prompt.md has the
Grok Imagine prompt, the framing constraint that keeps the headline
readable, and the encode settings.
